name: section_id
label: Section anchor ID (optional)
help_text: Used for in-page anchor links. Lower-case, hyphenated. Leave blank if not needed.

name: members_only
label: Members only
help_text: When true, this section is only rendered for logged-in active members.

name: intro
label: Default feature body text
help_text: Shown below the large pathway image when an individual pathway tab does not have its own Feature body text.

name: default_card_thumbnail
label: Default course card thumbnail
help_text: Fallback image used on the small course cards when a card-specific thumbnail is empty.

name: course_cards_source
label: Course cards source
help_text: Use HubDB to populate the small course cards from matching course categories. If no matching HubDB courses are found, the module automatically falls back to the manual Course cards repeater.

name: max_dynamic_courses
label: Maximum HubDB course cards per tab
help_text: Limits how many unique course pages are shown for each selector when using HubDB categories.

name: pathways
label: Pathway tabs
help_text: Each item controls one tab, its large image/content, and the small course cards shown on the right.

children.name: label_text
children.label: Tab label
children.help_text: Short label shown in the tab strip, e.g. 'Trade to AS1796'

children.name: pathway_heading
children.label: Pathway heading
children.help_text: Full heading shown inside the tab panel, e.g. 'Welder → AS1796 Certified'

children.name: summary
children.label: Short fallback body text
children.help_text: One-line description shown below the panel heading

children.name: feature_image
children.label: Feature image
children.help_text: Large image shown on the left of this pathway tab. If empty, a default welding image is used.

children.name: feature_caption
children.label: Large image overlay caption
children.help_text: Short label overlaid on the feature image, e.g. Welding inspector courses.

children.name: feature_body
children.label: Feature body text
children.help_text: Body copy shown below the feature image. If empty, the panel summary or section intro is used.

children.name: course_list_label
children.label: Course list button label
children.help_text: Optional. If empty, the module uses 'View all {tab label} courses'.

children.name: course_list_link
children.label: Course list button link
children.help_text: Optional. Overrides the destination below with an explicit URL.

children.name: course_list_division
children.label: Course list button destination
children.help_text: Where the “View all … courses” button goes. Auto derives the training division from the selected HubDB categories, falling back to the tab label. Choose “All courses” for pathways that are not a training division (e.g. ISO 3834). A “Course list button link” overrides this.

children.name: hubdb_categories
children.label: HubDB course categories
children.help_text: Optional. Select which HubDB course categories should appear in this tab. Leave empty to infer from the tab label, e.g. Welding Inspector → Welding Inspection.

children.name: steps
children.label: Course cards
children.help_text: Each item controls one small course card on the right: title, badge, duration, thumbnail and link.

children.name: qualification
children.label: Course card title
children.help_text: Main text shown on the course card.

children.name: description
children.label: Internal short description
children.help_text: Optional. Not shown in the compact card layout; used only to infer the delivery badge if Delivery badge text is empty.

children.name: thumbnail
children.label: Card thumbnail image
children.help_text: Small image used on the course card. If empty, a fallback course thumbnail is used.
